Hand off tasks to an AI agent running on your private computer

Pana can prepare meetings, manage shopping, mark up documents, and build custom mini-tools like meal trackers, inbox consolidators, and timers. It learns from your feedback, asks for approval when needed, and acts across connected services.

PopNow
AI videos, images, and songs from one photo or line of text
PopNow is a browser-based AI creative studio for videos, images, music, and voiceovers. It turns text or photos into short videos, animates images, and offers ready-made effects or model choices for each task. Image tools include generation, editing, background removal, object erasing, and upscaling. A visual Canvas helps organize images, clips, and audio in a single workflow. API and MCP integration support automated creation. Built for creators, marketers, designers, and small businesses, PopNow uses prepaid credits shared across tools. One-time credit packs start at $9, with no subscription required. It's available in 12 languages.

Launches
Submit your product and climb weekly community rankings
Launches is a weekly product launch board where makers can submit products any day and the community votes throughout the week. Each week features a curated list, with the highest-voted products rising to the top by the end of the voting period. The site focuses on simple discovery and fair visibility, making it easy to browse current launches, support favorites, and gain traction with an engaged audience.
